items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Live Junk Free makes sod removal simpler than you might think. We offer a fast, no-hassle way to remove old grass, roots, and topsoil from your yard, all without you breaking a sweat.

First, we provide a free, no-obligation quote with transparent pricing. Once approved, our crew arrives at your scheduled time to carefully strip away unwanted sod, clear the area, and haul everything away properly. Most residential sod removal projects take less than 2 hours.

We prioritize eco-friendly disposal. We don’t just dump sod – we compost quality organic material and recycle soil when possible. Our team uses professional sod removal tools and techniques to protect your landscape during the process.

items: We can remove sod from any area of your property, small garden patches, expansive lawns, or tricky sloped sections. Our crews take exceptional care to protect your landscaping features and prevent damage to your property during the removal process.

It doesn’t matter what type of grass you have, thick bluegrass, stubborn Bermuda, or delicate fescue. We expertly handle all varieties. Our team carefully cuts, rolls, and removes your sod, ensuring proper disposal, we recycle quality turf whenever possible through local composting programs.

items.q: Do you remove old or unwanted sod?
a: Yes, we professionally remove all types of sod – whether it’s dead, damaged, or simply unwanted. Our service includes full removal, cleanup, and disposal, leaving your property ready for new landscaping.

items.q: How much does sod removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 for basic residential removal. Larger projects receive volume discounts. Get a free exact quote by sharing photos/measurements of your lawn area.

items.q: What areas do you serve for sod removal?
a: We cover Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, and surrounding GTA communities. Contact us to confirm service availability for your specific location.

items.q: Can I schedule same-day sod removal?
a: Absolutely! Same-day service is available when booked, subject to crew availability. Weekend appointments are offered at no extra charge.

items.q: Do you handle large sod removal projects?
a: Yes, we routinely handle projects from small garden patches to commercial properties using professional-grade equipment.
